name: Token8633_9419
fix_description: In func_25EA, the function unconditionally calls external contract autoSwapAndAddToMarketing() during every transfer when storage[0x26] is set. This allows repeated price manipulation via transfers. Add cooldown, minimum threshold, or remove the auto-swap trigger from the transfer path.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a long, highly protocol-specific multi-step exploit involving a flash loan, repeated helper contract calls in large loops, pair manipulation, low-level external calls, and coordinated state changes across several contracts. Understanding why 130 iterations of autoAddLp and 900 iterations of autoSwapAndAddToMarketing create profit would require deep reasoning about the token/helper internals and AMM accounting, which pushes it well beyond a straightforward auditor write-up.
